# Lesson Plan

Outcome: show how to inspect a small command-line project, reproduce one failing check, make one bounded correction, and verify the same check passes.

1. State the task and the evidence required for success.
2. Inspect the project and identify the real test entrypoint.
3. Run the test and keep the first useful failure visible.
4. Make one correction and inspect the diff.
5. Rerun the same test and verify the result.
